records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Truckload services revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, represented 64.7% and 63.7% of total revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, for the quarters ended March 31, 2023, and 2022, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For both operations, substantially all of our revenue is generated by transporting freight for customers and is predominantly affected by the rates per mile received from our customers, equipment utilization, and our percentage of non-compensated miles.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The truckload services division operating ratio, which measures the ratio of operating expenses, net of fuel surcharges, to operating revenues, before fuel surcharges, increased from 81.4% for the first quarter of 2022 to 99.3% for the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: This percentage-based increase is primarily a result of the interaction of expenses with fixed-cost characteristics, such as general and administrative wages, maintenance wages, and operations wages with a decrease in revenue per mile for the periods compared, coupled with an increase in the number of employees during the first quarter of 2023 compared to the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022, approximately $28.3 million and $23.4 million, respectively, of the Company’s total revenue was generated from fuel surcharges.
